title: API test (REST)
description: Describe requests and expected responses. Runs through Scripts/api-test.sh.
needs: The API's base address, e.g. https://api.mycompany.com
The requests to send and the answer each one should give

target.label: Base URL
target.help: The address of the API, e.g. https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com — no path, no password in it.

target.label: How does the API check who you are?
target.help: Leave on 'none' for a public API. Passwords and tokens are never typed here: pick a saved secret.

target.label: Bearer token (saved secret)
target.help: Reference only: ${secret:NAME} or ${env:NAME}. Never paste the token.

target.label: API key name
target.help: The header or query-parameter name the API expects.

target.label: Fail responses slower than (ms)
target.help: A response slower than this counts as a failure. 5000 = 5 seconds.

target.label: Retry a failed request
target.help: Network errors and 502/503/504 answers are retried this many times before they count as a failure.

target.label: Extra headers sent with every request
target.help: One per line as Name: value, e.g. X-Api-Version: 2. Put secrets in as ${secret:NAME}, never the value itself.

target.label: Accept self-signed security certificates
target.help: Only for test servers you own. Turns off certificate checking for this run.

details.label: Requests
details.help: Each request: method, path, expected status, optional JSON body, optional text the response must contain.
